## 問題
北部客戶 2025 年 11 月的淨營收是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 13423113
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 status IN (1,2,3)、期間以台北時間訂單成立時間歸屬，地區為 customers.region_code = 'TW-N'。商品金額為 quantity × unit_price_cents（已含折扣）除以 100 換算為元，合計 14,041,575 元；退款以原訂單歸屬，合計 618,462 元。淨營收 = 14,041,575 − 618,462 = 13,423,113 元（1,525 筆有效訂單）。
SQL 1: ["SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status", "SELECT oi.unit_price_cents, oi.quantity, p.list_price_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LIMIT 10", "WITH v AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS gross_twd, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS refund_twd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) 
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status', 'columns': ['status', 'n'], 'rows': [[0, 3003], [1, 3549], [2, 4870], [3, 39574], [9, 9004]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT oi.unit_price_cents, oi.quantity, p.list_price_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN prod
SQL 2: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd * 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_x100, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_x1 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.quantity = 1", "WITH v AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price_cents * oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) / 100.0 AS gross_twd, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r 
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd * 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_x100, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_x1 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.quantity = 1

## 回答 B
最終答案: 13423113
採用的定義與依據: 北部客戶定義為 customers.region_code='TW-N'；期間以 order_ts+8 小時的台北時間歸屬 2025-11，有效訂單為 status IN (1,2,3)。淨營收 = 有效訂單商品金額（quantity×unit_price_cents/100，TWD）14,041,575 元 − 原訂單對應退款 618,462 元 = 13,423,113 元；退款皆能對應到訂單明細且未超過明細金額。
SQL 1: ["WITH nv AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)) AS gross_raw, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)) AS refund_twd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nv) AS valid_orders", "SELECT oi.item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, p.list_price_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LIMIT 10"]
  結果: [{'query': "WITH nv AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items o
SQL 2: WITH nv AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_item, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NOT NULL AND r.order_id <> oi.order_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_mismatch, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NOT NULL AND r.refund_amount_twd > oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents / 100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_item_refund FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)
  結果: {'columns': ['refund_rows', 'unmatched_item', 'order_mismatch', 'over_item_refund'], 'rows': [[123, 0, 0, 0]], 'truncated': False}

response:
Both same answer, same definitions. B validated refunds integrity; A validated unit conversion (cents vs list price). Both reasonable. B's refund check is extra; A's unit check confirms cents scaling. Tie or slight edge. A's verification of cents unit is more crucial for correctness of /100. B checked sample too (list_price comparison LIMIT 10). B additionally checked refunds mapping. Slight edge B? Both fine; I'll call tie.

{"winner": "tie", "reason": "兩者採用相同定義（TW-N、台北時間 2025-11、status IN (1,2,3)、cents/100、退款歸屬原訂單）並得出相同結果 13,423,113；A 額外驗證了單價的分/元單位換算，B 額外驗證了退款與明細的對應及金額上限，兩者的驗證各有側重，整體品質相當。", "critical_error": false}
